title: Voice and tone
slide_intent: Teach writers to choose language that respects the reader. Even a playful sign-off has consequences when it labels people or relies on an exclusionary phrase.
strategic_value: Slack can give writers an editorial boundary and a positive voice to aim for in the same spread.
demonstration: The left column discusses invented Slack terms and exclusionary expressions. The larger right statement connects authenticity with regard for the people being addressed.
practical_value: Check a playful phrase for invented brand jargon or language that could alienate a reader, then choose a clearer expression.

content_islands.name: Language boundaries
content_islands.spec: Place two short paragraphs in the left column with specific examples of terms to avoid and a test for uncertain wording.
